candidates.summary: the new fixture's only written assertion, `if !cur.IsCurrent()`, is dead code: a crossing function's own first `cur` is current by construction (25 lines -> 22 with it dropped, same regression power)
candidates.failure_scenario: curSubtestTarget is a crossing function, so the VM installs the value passed as that frame's own cur before the body runs; cur.IsCurrent() is then true whatever the sub-test was seeded with. Flipping the guard to `if cur.IsCurrent()` panics on every run, so the written branch can never be taken. The fixture's real assertion is only that the dispatch does not panic, and that fires at the func literal's entry (line 18) before the body is reached: with the exemption removed the panic names `func literal at cur_subtest_test.gno:18`, not the target. Shipped into the stdlib test suite it reads as an example of the IsCurrent-on-own-cur shape gnovm/adr/interrealm_v2.md calls dead code.
candidates.verify_by: copy tests/b4-lines-claims-tests-reach-refactor-catalog-iscurrent-vacuous.gno into gnovm/tests/stdlibs/testing/zzprobe_iscurrent_test.gno and run `go test ./gnovm/pkg/gnolang/ -run 'TestStdlibs/test-testing' -v`: the flipped guard panics. Then put tests/b4-lines-claims-tests-reach-refactor-catalog-rewrite.gno in place of the committed file: green at head, and still FAIL after `sed -i 's/ && !m.harnessSeedsCur()//' gnovm/pkg/gnolang/op_call.go`.
candidates.evidence: probe: `=== RUN TestZZProbeIsCurrentVacuous/sub` then `panic: IS-CURRENT-VACUOUS: the guard in cur_subtest_test.gno can never fire` / `--- FAIL: TestZZProbeIsCurrentVacuous (0.00s)`. rewrite at head: `ok github.com/gnolang/gno/gnovm/pkg/gnolang 2.889s`; rewrite with the exemption removed: `panic: crossing function testing_test func literal at cur_subtest_test.gno:16 was entered without cross()` / `FAIL`. Committed file with the exemption removed: same panic naming line 18, i.e. before curSubtestTarget is called.
